Shanghai Municipal Police. 27/5/16 (CH)
Central Police Station.
Shanghai, May 27, 1916.
REPORT ON Distribution of Revolutionary Pamphlets.
Made by D. S. Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir,
I beg to report that acting on instructions from the Captain Superintendent, at 9-45 p.m. on 26th inst. I arrested two newspaper venders named Sung Cheng Yen (孫金由) and Shun Tsu San (陳丹山) who were distributing pamphlets on Taku Road recounting the brutal doings of Northern soldiers in Szechuens
I took the men to the Sinza Station where they were detained pending advice from the Police Legal Adviser. I submitted a translation of the pamphlet to the Police Legal Adviser this morning, and he endorsed it for the information of the Captain Superintendent as follows:—
"I rather fear there is nothing exactly "seditious" in this, and I do not advise proceedings unless you think it ought to go forward in any case."
Attached please find one of the pamphlets and the translation.
The news paper venders said they got the pamphlets from Ming Sin Pao 民信報 newspaper office.
I am Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. S. Givens
Detective Sergeant.
Chief Detective Inspector.
（左侧竖排手写批注）：

上海公共租界工部局警务处。1916年5月27日 (CH)
中央巡捕房。
上海，1916年5月27日。
关于分发革命传单的报告。
由 D. S. Givens 呈报。经首席探长转呈。
敬启者：
卑职谨此报告，遵照警司指令，于本月26日晚9时45分，逮捕了两名正在大沽路分发传单的报贩，名为 Sung Cheng Yen（孫金由）和 Shun Tsu San（陳丹山），传单内容叙述北军在四川的暴行。
卑职将二人带至新闸巡捕房羁押，等候警务法律顾问的指示。今晨，卑职向警务法律顾问提交了该传单的译文，他批注供警司知悉如下：—
“我恐怕其中并没有确切属于‘煽动性’的内容，除非你认为无论如何都应推进此事，否则我不建议采取法律行动。”
随函附上该传单一份及译文。
据报贩称，他们是从《民信報》报社获得这些传单的。
卑职谨呈，
您顺从的仆人，
D. S. Givens
巡佐
首席探长
（左侧竖排手写批注）：
如果你指明那些传单，我会尽力而为。请采取措施防止此类事件再次发生，并将此卷宗移交警司，以便在5月29日关于雇佣营编号事宜上通知警察总监。
逮捕。《民信报》位于 Chapel Alley Road。
（底部手写批注）：
两名报贩，Sung Cheng Yen 和 Shun Tsu Sai，已于本月27日上午11时45分释放。
督察 Sims。
1916年5月27日。
传单已被没收。当值警察已获指令，禁止在上海公共租界内分发。

pages.en:
I, Chen Hua Cheng (陈华曾), a native of
Szechuen, beg respectfully to inform the public of what
I have suffered. I am over 70 years old and I did not
think that I should ever interfere in political affairs.
Unfortunately Heaven has permitted the present disasters.
On account of the change of the form of government a
rising was started in Yunnan and Kweichow. This caused
the despatch of the northern troops to Szechuen. Fighting
took place there two months ago in the course of which
numberless civilians suffered. My family resides at
Hsiang Hu Chang香湖场, Naiyi district. We have several
hundred neighbours. As soon as the northern troops arrived
at that place they looted all the inhabitants and when the
latter declined to allow them to take away the things
they desired, the soldiers acted brutally, massacring every
body. There are several hundred women in the town, named,
and all of them were raped. When the northern troops
were defeated, they removed their barracks to other places,
setting fire everywhere. All the houses of that town were
burnt. Alas! What have our people done to merit such
suffering? I am a scholar and poor. My son died a
long time ago and I am living with my wife, daughter-in-
law and grand daughter. On 25th February the northern
troops came to my house and took away my daughter-in-law
by force. On the following day I heard that she had
committed suicide and on 28th some more northern troops
came my house and asked me to inform them of the whereabouts
of my grand daughter. I was greatly alarmed. They then
went to the kitchen and took away the child who is only
twelve years old. On the evening of 3rd March, it
was raining when my wife and I heard some men knocking at
my door. Afterwards five northern troops entered my
house, under the pretext of avoiding the rain. They wished
my wife to sleep with them. My wife told them that
she was an old woman; she is over fifty. One of them
said that they did not desire her to bear children, so
her age did not matter. They stabbed me in the right leg
with their bayonets and as my wife declined to do what
they wished, they killed her with their bayonets. Alas!
three of the four members of my family were killed and
I know that some families there have suffered much worse
than mine. It is reported that the northern troops at
Luchow泸, Naiyi纳溪, Shihlai石蓝, Tienpu田坝
and other districts have been guilty of more brutal con-
duct. Now the Yunnan troops have arrived, and the northern
troops have retreated but my injured leg is not yet better.
My house has been burnt and I am homeless. I borrowed
a sheet of paper and a pen to record the above details.
I hope this will be printed and distributed by some
gentlemen for public information. Should some gentlemen
in view of our sufferings assist in restoring the
peace of the country I shall be obliged to them for ever.
pages.zh: 本人陈华曾，四川籍人，谨恭敬地向公众告知我所遭受的苦难。我已年逾七旬，从未想过会卷入政治事务。不幸的是，上天容许了当下的灾难。由于政体变更，云南和贵州发起了起义。这导致北军被派往四川。两个月前那里发生了战斗，无数平民在此期间受苦。我家住在纳溪县香湖场。我们有数百名邻居。北军一到达该地，便抢劫所有居民，当居民拒绝让他们带走想要的物品时，士兵们行为残暴，屠杀所有人。该镇有数百名妇女，全都被强奸。北军战败后，将营房撤至其他地方，到处放火。该镇的所有房屋都被烧毁。唉！我们的百姓做了什么要遭受这样的苦难？我是一介穷书生。我的儿子很久以前就去世了，我与妻子、儿媳和孙女同住。2月25日，北军来到我家，强行带走了我的儿媳。第二天，我听说她自杀身亡。28日，又有更多北军来到我家，要求我告知他们我孙女的下落。我大为惊恐。随后他们去厨房带走了那个只有十二岁的孩子。3月3日晚上，天下着雨，我和妻子听到有人敲门。随后五名北军以避雨为借口进入我家。他们想要我的妻子陪睡。我的妻子告诉他们，她是个老妇人，已年过五十。其中一人说，他们并不指望她生育，所以年龄无关紧要。他们用刺刀刺伤了我的右腿，由于我的妻子拒绝顺从他们的意愿，他们用刺刀杀害了她。唉！我家四口人中有三口被杀，而且我知道那里有些家庭遭受的苦难比我家更甚。据报道，北军在泸州、纳溪、石蓝、田坝等地区犯下了更为残暴的行为。现在滇军已经抵达，北军已撤退，但我受伤的腿尚未痊愈。我的房子被烧毁，我无家可归。我借了一张纸和一支笔记录下上述细节。希望各位绅士能将此印刷并分发，以供公众知晓。若有绅士鉴于我们的苦难，协助恢复国家和平，我将永远感激不尽。
